title: Phone Number Prefix
summary: Given an array of strings representing phone numbers, determine if any phone number is a prefix of another; return true if not, otherwise false.
statement: Given an array of strings representing phone numbers, determine if any phone number is a prefix of another; return true if not, otherwise false.
constraints: A phone-number list is consistent when no entry is a prefix of another distinct entry.
Return false if any prefix conflict exists and true otherwise.
Compare complete strings, including leading zeros.
hints: If one number prefixes another, it prefixes the next string after it in sorted order.
Check every adjacent sorted pair for that relation.
Absence of any adjacent conflict proves global consistency.
editorial: Absence of any adjacent conflict proves global consistency.

tests.explanation: No number prefixes another, so the list is consistent.
